title: MCP run_action: a business refusal inside the action's flow comes back as the engine chain ("Flow '…' failed: Node '…' failed: update_record(…) failed: 电子发票 is required"), while the console shows 「电子发票不能为空」
body:
Filing category: ① product defect (agent-facing message).
reach: public entries `/api/v1/mcp` `run_action` and the console button, measured on a hosted tenant (`pnpm dev:stack --with-ui`; cloud `ff373e02`, framework `d7c3d44e`), member's MCP OAuth token and browser session.

## Business reason

The agent relays the refusal to the employee. "Flow 'ebqu_claim_submit' failed: Node 'set_pending' failed: update_record(ebqu_claim) failed: 电子发票 is required" tells them about flows and nodes; the console tells them the one thing to do.

## What happens

Action `ebqu_submit_claim` (type flow → `update_record status: pending`); field `invoices` has `requiredWhen: "record.status == 'pending'"`; the claim has no invoice.
- MCP `run_action` → `isError: true`, `FLOW_FAILED`, message `Flow 'ebqu_claim_submit' failed: Node 'set_pending' failed: update_record(ebqu_claim) failed: 电子发票 is required`, plus the node summary; the inner `VALIDATION_FAILED` sits under `details.innerRefusal`.
- Console 提交审批 → `POST /api/v1/actions/ebqu_claim/ebqu_submit_claim` 400 with the same chain; the toast reads 「电子发票不能为空」.

## Expected

When a flow fails on a declared refusal (`VALIDATION_FAILED`, `RECORD_LOCKED`, …), the action's answer leads with that refusal's code and its localized message (as the console toast does), with the flow/node chain kept as detail.

Reader who acts: the `packages/mcp` seat (`run_action` result shaping) or the automation seat (flow failure envelope).
Dedupe: `repo:objectstack-ai/objectstack is:issue run_action flow failed node message technical` → 4 hits, PM seats only.
